method: Full matches with a 1,000-turn cap, unresolved games count as nonwins. Historical challengers are known sparring partners. The learned pressure policy quotes a scaled public neural valuation and uses no challenger-specific parameter vector. Direct and history-gated profiles share fitted bidding weights. The gate finalist with the top screening rank is selected before its reported confirmation results.
provenance_note: The original screening and single-game confirmation were collected from a standalone harness. The package confirmation was run against the fully integrated native styles 9, 10 and 11 and the verified package routines.
